scope: profilehooks.py lines1-440 read with pinned Git blob verification; static review only, no decorator installation, atexit registration or tracing
findings: FuncProfile preserves target return through profiler.runcall and clears in_profiler in finally. However stats.add and immediate report/reset are in same finally, so reporting exceptions may replace the target exception. Static finding.

FuncProfile.in_profiler is one shared class flag, not thread-local; recursive and nested decorated calls intentionally bypass new profiling. Concurrent independent calls may also bypass it, unqualified without runtime.

profile() passes immediate/dirs/sort/entries to every backend constructor, but legacy HotShotFuncProfile constructor accepts only fn/skip/filename in viewed lines. Fallback backend selection can raise unexpected-keyword TypeError; static only.
Wrappers assign new_fn.__dict__ = fn.__dict__, sharing mutable metadata instead of copying it. No wrapper execution performed.
Intro explicitly warns about nested profiling support, inaccurate hotshot timing/coverage, and retained temporary files. These historical warnings are not blanket runtime findings for cProfile.
